extDescription.message: Removes Shorts and turns the YouTube home page from an endless feed into a showcase you cannot play videos from.

tagline.message: Less feed, zero Shorts, and only what you planned to watch.

toastText.message: Opening videos from the feed is off. Save it to Watch later instead.

blockedText.message: Youtube Focus intercepted a short video. If you came here for something specific, it is probably already on your plan.

homeShowcaseHint.message: The feed stays visible, but clicking a video does nothing. The native Watch later button on the thumbnail keeps working — that is how you fill the plan.

homeRedirectHint.message: youtube.com is replaced with your planned list.

plannedHint.message: Defaults to the native Watch later playlist. It must point to youtube.com and have a non-empty path.

shortsHideHint.message: A direct link to Shorts keeps working.

hideSidebarHint.message: Also removes end screens on top of the player. The player itself does not move.

showToast.message: Show a hint on a dead click

showToastHint.message: Otherwise a click in the feed just looks like a broken site.

statusSaved.message: Saved. Reload the YouTube tab if it is already open.

statusSavedFallback.message: That plan address did not work, Watch later restored. Saved.

statePaused.description: Состояние в попапе, $MINUTES$ — целое число минут

stateRedirect.message: Home goes to your plan, Shorts blocked.
